hypothesis: Can the complete-sequence path handle all observed length extremes within memory, and what is its short throughput cost?
source: Original eligible rows only, corpus and index hashes verified on CPU.
timing_scope: Pretokenized CPU batches, device transfers, forward/backward and optimizer updates. Tokenization timing is separate; no loader-prefetch speed claim.
gate: Require all runs finite, including long-example stress, within memory. Report observed throughput and peak memory, without selecting a training recipe from a speed-only probe.
